english.title: Ride a motor cycle on a road and fail to wear protective headgear
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(B)_[rode on]_

a motor bicycle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), without wearing protective headgear
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 4 of the Motor Cycles (Protective Helmets) Regulations 1998, section 16(4) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) Persons riding in a sidecar are exempt from this requirement, as are followers of the Sikh religion while wearing a turban (see Section 16(2) Road Traffic Act 1988). See regulation 4(2) for other exceptions.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) Fixed penalty scheme may be applied
